race.comment: VINARI (6) has the right recent form profile to take this out, with a close Cootamundra second as well as a sound Orange fourth where she was supported and beaten only a length and a half. The 2kg claim helps her present as the most reliable winning option, and her record around 1300m is solid enough for this assignment. RACY THOUGHTS (8) is the immediate danger after a strong first-up second in Class 2 grade at Wagga, and his narrow Class 1 win at Gundagai before that gives the form some depth. DOUBTFREE (7) brings the freshest winning performance, having beaten Vaderlee by just under two lengths at Wangaratta, and the third-up timing is attractive despite that win coming at big odds. RIVERBEND UNICORN (9) has been safely held in Class 2 company, but the last run had genuine excuses and the drop in grade gives him a path back into the placings.
